Fourth audit fixes. The Steam build links its key with a signature over the very ticket (hs-cert-link-v1) - the cert request signature, the same in every request, can no longer move a key to another Steam account. "Suppress client webhooks" really goes over the network (it was never serialized). One helper learns a server's key (never one from the localhost fallback, also on the password paths), and netcode no longer reports a key mismatch for a server on the fallback address; an entry found only by its internal address gives no key to expect. known_servers: read again before saving (two games), CRLF, one entry per address however written, no work per frame; save_as_text_atomic with a temporary file of its own. One plain_text_reason for every HTTP error shown (cert, link check, link), the broker named as configured, 429 "busy", 0/-1 "could not reach". verify() tells why a cert failed and the server says that, not a guess; broker keys read once. Linking: a refusal after linking (a banned Steam account) is a failure, a lost answer is asked about instead of reported as one, the unlink answer parsed as JSON, the Steam cert kept while a ranked match can be rejoined, a constant-time state check, the listener with short keep-alive so stop() never waits. Key files: account.key gone while playing is written back (no silent new account), a damaged one offers "Write the key back" and Show key file in folder, Backup has "Save a copy..." (any platform, macOS via AppleScript, also the open dialog there) with the instruction in the modal, the file dialogs' filters work (zenity, kdialog, Windows; All files), chosen files capped at 4 KB, backup files named by the key, Windows path strings that do not throw, wide/DNS host name, COM around the dialogs. Web: Restore reads UTF-16 files and says when a file is too large, Download inside the switch/new account modals, one storage sync around Restore/Forget and backups removed at start only next to a key, a notice for blocked or embedded storage, auth_redirect hands the code over at once and says what happened, BroadcastChannel optional. CrazyGames: the JWT decoded as base64url UTF-8, its lifetime by its own clock, a 401 renews the token, a new token retries at once, Sign in when already signed in on the portal and portal sign-ins picked up; itch.io and CrazyGames guests see why ranked servers are not for them. UI: Link with Steam... / Unlink... in Info, the sign-in failure reason under it and a spinner while retrying, the Refresh spinner stops on a failure, a server password field warns when the key was not verified, the server list mismatch says to refresh the list, "Signing in" has Join anyway / Cancel and never yanks the player out of another mode, clearer MMR, unlink, waiting and avatar texts, the nickname not reset while typed. Masterserver: no heartbeats after notified_server_list is cleared (goodbye first), resolving retried every 10 s with one log, removed lists told goodbye, a list equal to the main one skipped, 64 nonces. A server never runs with a made-up key.
